json.description: Click-intercept modal for /demo/<slug>/* pages. When a visitor on a demo page clicks a button or link that targets another page WITHIN the same demo, this modal opens first — explaining that the site is illustrative and surfacing real pricing / contact CTAs. After dismiss, the original navigation proceeds.

eyebrow.default: Heads up — this is a demo
eyebrow.description: Tiny pill label above the heading.

body.description: 1-2 sentence explanation of what the visitor is seeing.

pricingCta.description: { label, href } — primary CTA, typically pointing at the brand's real /pricing/ page.

continueLabel.description: Label for the link that lets the visitor proceed to the originally-clicked demo page.

interceptOncePerSession.description: Default false — every demo-page click opens the modal so the disclosure stays consistent across the visit. Set true to show once per demo per browser session and let subsequent clicks navigate freely.
